apriltag3-d2.library: AprilTag 3 (AprilRobotics/apriltag, C library via a ctypes shim)

aruco-nano.build: g++ -O3 -std=c++17 against OpenCV 4.14.0 (Release, IPP-ICV, pthreads, baseline SSE3 + dispatch)
aruco-nano.library: ArUco Nano (rmsalinas/aruco_nano, header-only C++ via a ctypes shim)

locus.build: PyPI abi3 manylinux wheel (maturin --release, no target-cpu flags)
locus.threading: scoped Rayon pool of `threads` workers per detector

locus-d2.build: PyPI abi3 manylinux wheel (maturin --release, no target-cpu flags)
locus-d2.threading: scoped Rayon pool of `threads` workers per detector

napa.decimation: none (sparse rake; every level fits corners at full resolution)
napa.noisy_frame_box_averaging: noisy frames: original stride 1; centred 3x3 at stride 2 following stride 1; stride-sized blocks otherwise
napa.threading: none inside a frame; one instance per thread

napa-mtp16.decimation: none (sparse rake; every level fits corners at full resolution)
napa-mtp16.noisy_frame_box_averaging: noisy frames: original stride 1; centred 3x3 at stride 2 following stride 1; stride-sized blocks otherwise
napa-mtp16.threading: none inside a frame; one instance per thread

opencv.effective_min_marker_side: perimeter >= 0.03 * max(w, h): about 5 px at 640, 14 px at 1920

opencv-aruco3.effective_corner_refinement: none (forced SUBPIX runs on zero pyramid levels at full-scale detection)
opencv-aruco3.tuning: tuned: useAruco3Detection (defaults; no refinement runs at full scale)

opencv-aruco3-half16.effective_corner_refinement: subpix on the upsampling pyramid levels
opencv-aruco3-half16.effective_min_marker_side: about 32 px (canonical side 16 px at scale 0.5; the contour gate is 4 x canonical side in the scaled image)
opencv-aruco3-half16.tuning: tuned for speed: ArUco3 at half scale, canonical 16 px (effective min side ~32 px)

opencv-aruco3-min32.effective_corner_refinement: subpix on the upsampling pyramid levels
opencv-aruco3-min32.effective_min_marker_side: about 64 px (canonical side 32 px at scale 0.5; the contour gate is 4 x canonical side in the scaled image)
opencv-aruco3-min32.tuning: tuned for speed: ArUco3 at half scale, canonical 32 px (effective min side ~64 px)

opencv-subpix.effective_min_marker_side: perimeter >= 0.03 * max(w, h): about 5 px at 640, 14 px at 1920

rapidtag.build: PyPI abi3 manylinux wheel (portable; no target-cpu=native)
rapidtag.input_copy: copies the frame into a Vec on every call (lib.rs extract_frame)
rapidtag.threading: global Rayon pool over threshold scales; RAPIDTAG_CORES=2

rapidtag-subpix.build: PyPI abi3 manylinux wheel (portable; no target-cpu=native)
rapidtag-subpix.input_copy: copies the frame into a Vec on every call (lib.rs extract_frame)
rapidtag-subpix.threading: global Rayon pool over threshold scales; RAPIDTAG_CORES=2

wpilib-d2.tuning: WPILib's defaults (quad_decimate=2, min cluster 300 px, critical angle 45 degrees)
